description: Update a filoo short link in place: change its destination (the previous destination is kept in the audit history so the short URL is safe to repoint), edit its label, or disable/re-enable it with active. The short_url itself never changes. Useful for keeping a stable short URL while migrating the target.

active.description: Set false to disable the link, true to re-enable.

destination.description: New long URL to redirect to.

name: filoo_update_link
